en: Multiview color tourist postcard showing scenes from the Danube Delta near Tulcea: a fisherman hoisting a huge fish on a riverside pier, a colony of pelicans flying low over a channel, and a shady village path along the water with boats and willows. The reverse has Romanian printed layout, a 40 bani Poșta Română stamp, and postmarks from Tulcea/București, addressed in blue ink.
